assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded with CPT 93229
The member presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmia
The member has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
SilverBridge Advantage requires prior approval for this specific diagnostic procedure
The claim is associated with the SilverBridge Advantage payer
